findings.label: Unused coordinator trace-parent plumbing
findings.detail: OrchestratorInput.tracerParent and LoopContext.tracerParent are declared and consumed by RunTracer but never supplied by any caller: runAgent's runOrchestrated call omits tracerParent, and prepareRun never assigns ctx.tracerParent (there is no RunAgentOptions.tracerParent). The coordinator span is therefore always a fresh root, so the 'run -> coordinator -> worker -> step' tree claimed in code comments and ci-task7.md is really 'coordinator -> worker -> step'. Harmless (undefined falls back to a fresh trace) and outside the strict 7.3 deliverable. Either wire a run span above the coordinator or drop the field and soften the wording.
